text:
Alex S: Quick sync — SwiftBridge wants a 10-day POC to migrate off CompetitorBridge. Blockers: pricing model mismatch (per-call vs per-token), webhook signature/header differences, prompt/response shape, and KMS requirements. Can SEs/security weigh in? cc @Mina R @Carlos Sec
Mina R: They use mostly non-streaming completions + embeddings. They need semantic parity, but procurement insists on a capped PO for the POC so they don't get surprised on billing.
Carlos Sec: Security asks: EU data residency, SAML SSO for admins, weekly audit exports, and customer-managed KMS for at-rest keys. Hosted supports IP allowlist + HMAC webhook signatures; Dedicated required for CMK/HSM and mTLS callbacks. Need their questionnaire PDF and expected rps.
Jules CS: Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) semantic parity >= 92% on spot-checks, 2) token delta <= 15% for POC workload, 3) p95 latency < 300ms, 4) webhook delivery >= 99% with retries.
Mina R: Technical plan (compact): Day 0: creds + handshake; Day 1-2: parity smoke (500 prompts side-by-side, BLEU/embedding diff + 30 human checks); Day 3: billing replay to estimate cap; Day 4-5: scale & fallbacks.
Mina R: Handshake snippet to share with their engs:
```
# get token
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/token -d '{"client_id":"SW-POC","client_secret":"<redacted>"}'
# call
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-medium-1","input":"Show last payment"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Carlos Sec: CompetitorBridge uses header X-CB-Sig (HMAC-SHA256). We'll include mapping to X-RW-Signature and an adapter example. If they require mTLS for callbacks, recommend Dedicated and flag lead time.
QuoteBot: Reminder: capped POCs need RevOps approval. Include expected token volume in the quote.
Alex S: Owners: Mina (tech lead), Carlos (security), Jules (commercial). I'll request their anonymized top-200 prompts and the security questionnaire now. :thumbsup:
